1.w: Hear the word of YHWH, O sons of Israel, for a case [is] unto YHWH against those dwelling in the land: “For there is no truth, and there is no loving devotion, and there is no knowledge of God in the land.

2.w: Cursing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break all restraint, and bloodshed touches upon bloodshed.

3.w: Upon thus mourns the land, and languish all dwelling in it; with the beasts of the field and the birds of the heavens, and even the fish of the sea, they are gathered up.

4.w: Only let no man contend and no man rebuke, for your people [are] like those who contend with a priest.

5.w: And you will stumble by day, and will stumble also the prophet with you by night, and I will destroy your mother.

6.w: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge, because you have rejected knowledge, and I will reject you from being priest unto Me; and you have forgotten the law of your God; I will forget your children also.

7.w: According to their becoming numerous, so they sinned against Me; their Glory they exchanged for shame.

8.w: The sin of My people they eat up, and toward their iniquity they lift up their soul.

9.w: And it will be like people, like priest; and I will visit punishment on them for their ways, and their deeds I will repay to them.

10.w: For they will eat, and they will not be satisfied; they will prostitute themselves and not increase, because they have abandoned to give heed to YHWH.

11.w: Prostitution and wine and new wine take the heart.

12.w: My people consult with a piece of wood, and their staff declares [it] to them; for the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have prostituted themselves from under their God.

13.w: On the tops of the mountains they sacrifice, and on the hills they burn incense, under oak and poplar and terebinth, because its shade [is] good. In this [way] your⁺ daughters prostitute themselves, and your⁺ brides commit adultery.

14.w: I will not visit punishment on your⁺ daughters when they prostitute themselves, or on your⁺ brides when they commit adultery; for they themselves go off with the prostitutes, and offer sacrifices with shrine prostitutes, and a people without understanding will be thrown down.

15.w: Though you prostitute yourself, O Israel, do not let Judah become guilty; and do not come to Gilgal, and do not go up [to] Beth-Aven, and do not swear an oath, ‘As YHWH lives.’

16.w: For being stubborn like a heifer, Israel is stubborn; now will YHWH let them graze like a lamb in a broad pasture?

17.w: Ephraim is joined to idols; leave him alone!

18.w: Has turned aside their liquor, they engage in flagrant prostitution; her rulers dearly love love dishonor.

19.w: The wind has constrained her in its wings, and they will be ashamed of their sacrifices.
